text:
Nora Li: Quick UX bug from today's session: when you keyboard-reorder rules fast, the priority handle loses visible focus in dark theme. Also the simulation toast disappears before screen readers announce completion.
James Ortiz: Repro steps?
Nora Li: Policies > add 3 rules > focus rule > press space then arrow keys fast > run preview. Chrome on mac.
Priya Desai: Recommend bump focus ring to 3px using --focus token and provide an sr-only status update: 'Rule X moved to position Y'. Use aria-live='polite' for normal sim end; assertive for errors.
design-bot: Accessibility scan: hit target <32px flagged. Expand interactive area for handle.
James Ortiz: Plan: CSS tweak + aria-grabbed + sticky sim summary panel (ETA this sprint). I'll open a PR and tag Priya.
Nora Li: Also change validation copy from 'Rule conflict' to 'Two rules match the same input — change order or narrow a matcher.' Add a docs link in the tooltip.
Priya Desai: I'll add a11y checks to the card and verify after merge.
Nora Li: Thanks — small fixes but important.
